choices.content: Any two polygons whose corresponding angles are equal are similar.

question.prompt: Which of the following statements is correct?

solutions.explanation: All angles of a square are \(90^\circ\), and the ratios of corresponding side lengths are equal throughout, so squares are necessarily similar. Rectangles guarantee equal corresponding angles but need not have proportional corresponding sides; rhombuses guarantee proportional corresponding sides but need not have equal corresponding angles. Thus rectangles and rhombuses are not necessarily similar within their respective classes. D lacks the condition that the sides are proportional. Therefore, the correct choice is C.
solutions.title: Compare the similarity conditions
